blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Office of the Ombudsman is opening an “Investors’ Window” where business owners and investors can submit concerns about government officials or transactions that impede business operations. Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla made the announcement on Thursday during a dialogue with Cebu “lechoneros” (pig roasters), as noted in a statement issued on Friday. At the forum, he expressed sadness that there is a growing “impunity of corruption” affecting businesses. According to him, certain public officials across various levels of the government have been exploiting their positions to demand money from businesses in exchange for permits, approvals and other government services.
